# OurMoney - Complete guide

> The first finance app built specifically for couples. A shared household budget, fair expense splitting, privacy.

## What is OurMoney?

OurMoney is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that lets couples manage their finances together.
It combines the simplicity of a spreadsheet with features built for two people.

## The problem we solve

Couples running a shared budget keep hitting the same problems:
- Who paid how much, and for what?
- How do you split expenses fairly when incomes differ?
- Where does the shared budget end and the private one begin?
- Spreadsheets are tedious, and apps like Splitwise settle debts rather than run a budget.

## Key features

### Smart expense splitting
Three modes: 50/50, proportional to income, or custom shares.
Every expense is automatically attributed to the right person.

### Mine-Yours-Ours
Three financial spaces: a private one for each partner, plus a shared one.
Full control over what the other person can see.

### Shared financial goals
Save together for holidays, a renovation or a house deposit.
Progress tracked in real time.

### AI reports and analysis
Automatic expense categorisation.
Monthly summaries, trends and concrete recommendations.

### PWA - works like a native app
Installs on the phone without the App Store or Google Play.
Works offline, fast and responsive.

## Who is OurMoney for?

- Couples living together and sharing costs
- Partners on different incomes looking for a fair split
- People tired of spreadsheets
- Couples planning shared financial goals (wedding, home, holidays)

## Pricing

### Free plan - 0 PLN forever
No credit card, no trial period, never expires.
Includes: shared budget for two people, unlimited expenses and income,
splitting evenly / proportionally to income / mine-yours-ours,
shared goals and envelopes, the PWA on your phone.
Limits: limited number of custom categories, shortened transaction history,
1 bank statement import per month, up to 5 receipt scans per month,
no AI analysis and no automatic bank integration.

### Premium - 39.99 PLN per month or 399.99 PLN per year
Annual billing means 2 months free. Prices in PLN, gross.
Premium covers everything in the free plan without the limits, plus:
unlimited custom categories, full transaction history, monthly AI analysis
with recommendations, unlimited statement imports and receipt scans,
and a bank integration that pulls transactions in automatically.
Premium can be switched on and off inside the app at any time.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do we both need the app?**
Not to begin with. One person can start alone and invite their partner later.

**Is the app free?**
Yes, the basic version is free forever and needs no card. Day-to-day budgeting has no
limits. Only AI analysis, bank integration and lifting the history and import limits
are paid.

**How does expense splitting work?**
Choose between an even split (50/50), proportional to income (e.g. 60/40), custom
shares, or simply tracking expenses without settling them. OurMoney calculates the
shares automatically.

**Does it work on iOS and Android?**
Yes. OurMoney is a PWA - installed straight from the browser, without the App Store or
Google Play. On iPhone via Safari ("Add to Home Screen"), on Android via Chrome
("Install app").

**Is our data safe?**
The connection to the app is encrypted with TLS. Data is never sold, there are no ads,
processing follows GDPR, and data can be deleted at any time.
